title: Gearmotor · Exterior parts
attribution: Helical gearmotor by Innerscene Corp · CC0 1.0
scope: A five-action virtual exterior walkthrough. The model includes covers, a cooling fan, end shields and an output shaft. An internal rotor and reduction gears are not modelled. These illustrative part separations are not instructions for servicing a real motor.

parts.title: Terminal lid
parts.detail: The top cover and its screws form one virtual movement group.

parts.title: Fan cover
parts.detail: The outer guard covers the cooling fan at the back of the motor.

parts.title: Cooling fan
parts.detail: A separate fan sits behind the rear end shield.

parts.title: Rear end shield
parts.detail: The rear end shield is separate from the finned motor body.

parts.title: Output shaft
parts.detail: The visible output shaft, key and seal are grouped for this model inspection.

parts.title: Motor body
parts.detail: The frame, cooling fins, terminal box and front shield form the main exterior group.

parts.title: Gear unit
parts.detail: The external gearbox housing and motor adapter stay together. Internal gears are not included.

steps.title: Look below the terminal lid
steps.instruction: Play the model movement to lift the terminal lid and its screws. Rotate the view to see the top of the terminal box.

steps.title: Reveal the cooling fan
steps.instruction: Slide the virtual fan cover away from the motor. The fan stays in place so you can see how the guard surrounds it.

steps.title: Separate the rear groups
steps.instruction: Watch the fan and rear end shield separate from the body. This model shows the external groups; it does not contain the internal rotor.

steps.title: Inspect the output side
steps.instruction: Watch the output shaft group separate from the gear housing. Rotate the model to find the shaft, key and seal.

steps.title: Bring the exterior together
steps.instruction: Replay the return movement to see all of the model groups line up with their original positions.
